svg.title: orbit architecture
svg.desc: orbit architecture. 6 components in 2 groups. Connections: You to orbit web app; orbit web app to orbit API (REST + JWT); orbit API to Neon PostgreSQL (psycopg 3); orbit web app to GitHub OAuth (sign-in redirect); orbit API to GitHub OAuth (code exchange); GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages (deploy); GitHub Actions to Neon PostgreSQL (alembic upgrade).

text.tspan: Production. In dev the API runs on :8000 with SQLite, behind the Vite /api proxy.
GITHUB ACTIONS ON PUSH TO MAIN
